A 2x2 grid of FOUR separate, independent card illustrations arranged in two rows and two columns, separated by thin plain white gutters. Each panel is its own complete picture with its own very pale background.

Panel 1 (top-left), very pale pink background: A girl happily opens a colourful envelope and pulls out a party invitation card that shows only three balloons and no words at all. Everything in this panel is small and fully inside it, with clear empty space on all four sides.
Panel 2 (top-right), very pale yellow background: A boy drinks a glass of cold lemonade with a straw; a small sun is in the sky well inside the panel. Everything in this panel is small and fully inside it, with clear empty space on all four sides.
Panel 3 (bottom-left), very pale cream background: A girl holds a ringing phone and looks curiously at the screen; the screen is blank. Everything in this panel is small and fully inside it, with clear empty space on all four sides.
Panel 4 (bottom-right), very pale sky-blue background: A boy holds a phone against his chest and calls to his sister in another room. Everything in this panel is small and fully inside it, with clear empty space on all four sides.

Copy only the drawing style of the reference image (line weight, flat colours), NOT its subject. Do NOT draw the snake, the fly, any green creature or any loose eye from the reference image anywhere.

COMPOSITION in EVERY panel: the subject occupies about 65% of the panel height, fully visible, with a WIDE even margin of empty background on all four sides — nothing touches or comes near the panel edge. Seen straight on, flat, not in perspective. Centred in its panel. People are shown full body including both feet with empty space below them, fully clothed, with friendly faces.

NO white outline around the subjects. NO sticker border, NO die-cut edge, NO cut-out effect. The artwork sits directly on the flat background.

ABSOLUTELY FLAT colour fills. NO gloss, NO shine, NO metallic sheen, NO specular highlights, NO reflections, NO gradients, NO soft shading, NO texture, NO drop shadow, NO ground shadow, NO shadow under feet or objects, NO ambient occlusion, NO 3D depth. Each object is a base colour plus at most one slightly lighter flat tone.

Every shape outlined with a confident medium-thick, evenly rounded stroke in a darker tone of its own fill colour, the same weight as the reference.

BACKGROUND of each panel: one single very pale washed-out tint as given, extremely light, close to white. Completely empty apart from what is described — no ground, no horizon, no pattern.

Inanimate objects have NO faces, NO eyes, NO mouths, NO limbs (robots and toys excepted).

No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere in the image; signs, papers, packages, labels and screens are blank.

Child-friendly and wholesome: nothing scary, violent, dangerous, religious, romantic or rude.
